notes: All 12 texts are Common Crawl captures; sourceUrl is the index lookup address from each footer and sourceDate the capture timestamp date. (1) UMass Amherst ScholarWorks "Open Access Dissertations"/"Dissertations": a university-wide ETD list, not a program page; both captures show page 1 of 9 only (authors A to Mc under "Dissertations from 2013") and their entries are identical. No management, operations or business department appears on the captured page; the department printed after each author is recorded as program, degree is not printed (null), and the year is recorded with yearMeaning "unstated" because the heading says only "Dissertations from 2013". The integrator may drop these rows as out of scope. (2) Warwick WRAP "Browse by Theses by Department" for Warwick Business School (291 items in 2013, 330 in 2014) and its predecessor name School of Industrial and Business Studies (45 items in 2013, 50 in 2014): every entry is cited "PhD thesis, University of Warwick"; the year in parentheses is the thesis year in the WRAP citation, recorded as "unstated"; department names are not printed in the page body and were taken from the page URL. The ".type.html" captures were checked programmatically and list exactly the same thesis entries as the ".html" captures, so each person has four Warwick rows per department (two page keys x two captures). One journal article (Edwards, Rachel M., 2006, SCONUL Focus) appears in the WBS lists and was skipped as not a thesis. Names are copied as catalogued, including birth-year qualifiers ("Brough, Richard, 1953-"), "Ph.D." or "Dr." suffixes and cataloguer qualifiers such as "(Researcher in business)". The 2014 captures add theses dated 2013-2014 and some older ones absent from the 2013 captures. The two Warwick departments should be reconciled as one program (SIBS was renamed WBS). (3) UWM Lubar School "Graduates" page under the PhD program: entries give name, dissertation title, month and year, advisor and a placement; the year is recorded as "graduation" following the brief's "Graduates with years" rule although the page itself does not label the date. Program is the section heading (Finance, Management Information Systems, Marketing, Organizations and Strategic Management, Supply Chain and Operations Management; the last is the operations-relevant one). Where the page gives both an "Initial Placement" and a "Current Placement", destination/position are the initial placement and the full text is in note; where only one placement is given the page usually does not say whether it is initial or current, which the note flags; "Current Placement" given alone is recorded as written and flagged.
